Results.ReviewText: I bought this multi-tool mainly to help shape and clean up the trees and bushes in my yard without having to pay someone every time. It comes with 4 different attachments string trimmer, edger, hedge trimmer, and a brush cutter so I can switch between tasks easily depending on what I need that day. I mostly use the hedge trimmer to shape my trees, and it works surprisingly well. It’s powerful enough to handle thick branches but still gives me control for more detailed shaping. I was originally just looking to save some money on yard work, but now I kind of enjoy doing it myself. Overall, really happy with this tool, feels sturdy, does the job, and gives me multiple tools in one without having to buy everything separately. Definitely worth it if you want to take care of your yard yourself and save on professional landscaping costs.

325371505.Description: The 26cc 4-in-1 Multi-Tool with LinkOn attachments is a versatile tool. With attachments such as a string trimmer, edger, brush cutter blade, and articulating hedge trimmer, this kit serves many of your lawn needs. Add a pole saw to your combo for a complete multi-tool that does it all (pole saw attachment sold separately). This landscaping, tool-free, LinkOn attachment system is essential to your shed and saves space where it counts. Powered by a 26CC, 2-cycle, full-crank engine, the multi-tool is designed for reliability. The full crankshaft engine starts easily and runs smooth, reducing emissions, increasing fuel efficiency, and delivering longer life. The transmission is supported by a vented aluminum casing which greatly increases engine life and reduces vibration allowing you to work in comfort until the job is done. This tool includes a support harness to increase control and stability. Notes about the product: This machine takes a mix of both gasoline and oil (sold separately).
